g.text: can be used in cross function reentrancies:
External call into an untrusted contract before state is updated. An attacker contract can
re-enter the function and drain funds because the balance/state is still the pre-update value. This is the
external call, or use a reentrancy guard modifier.
// External call to an attacker-controlled receiver...
// ...and only THEN the state is updated.
/// @notice Batch withdraw for several users (loop with external call).

+> apply checks-effects-interactions; update balances before external calls

Preference of low-level calls over high-level Solidity calls. Low-level calls bypass checks and
return raw bools; they hide errors and enable subtle bugs.
